user.title: Build a Phrase Router rule
user.description: Pick what kind of entity this rule controls, and optionally require one or more labels. Every entity of that type carrying all of the labels (in whichever area this rule applies to) becomes a target - leave the label field blank to target every entity of that type in that area instead.

area_scope.title: Which room does this apply to?
area_scope.description: "Whichever room heard it" uses the area of whatever voice satellite/device the phrase was spoken to - walk into a room and say it, and it targets that room automatically.

wordings.title: Phrases
wordings.description: Comma-separated. "Toggle" is required and is what runs if neither of the others match - except for Locks, where toggle is optional (it unlocks whichever targets are currently locked and locks the rest, since there's no single lock "toggle" service) and at least one of toggle/on/off must be filled in instead. "On"/"Off" are optional explicit wordings; for Covers "on" opens and "off" closes, and for Locks "on" unlocks and "off" locks. Response on success and response when the action fails are shown here; the less-common not-found/unknown-room responses are in the section below - every response is independent and optional, and blank keeps that outcome's original behavior (Assist's default reply on success, silence on no match, the built-in "not sure which room" reply, or letting the error propagate). Any response field can hold more than one line - each line is a candidate reply, and one is picked at random every time the rule fires, so it doesn't always say the exact same thing back.

more_responses.name: More responses
more_responses.description: Less commonly customized - leave either blank to keep its original behavior. Any response field can hold more than one line - each line is a candidate reply, and one is picked at random every time the rule fires, so it doesn't always say the exact same thing back.

data.response_unknown_room: Response when the room can't be resolved (optional)

name.title: Name this rule
name.description: Suggested from the domain, label, and room you picked - type your own if you'd rather.

light_controls.title: Light Controls (optional)
light_controls.description: Only for Lights. Each field is optional and comma-separated, same as the Phrases above - leave any blank to skip it. Brightness and warmth each have three named levels plus a free-number wording (say a percent for brightness, or a Kelvin value for warmth - whatever number is heard gets used, clamped to a safe range). Color reacts to a small built-in set of color names (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink) inside whatever you type here - one wording covers all of them rather than a field per color. These share this rule's own success/error/not-found/unknown-room responses above, not a separate set.

data.brightness_number: Brightness: set to a percent (e.g. "set the lights to '{value}' percent")
data.warmth_number: Warmth: set to a value (e.g. "set the warmth to '{value}'")

error.toggle_required: Enter at least one toggle wording.
error.wording_required: Enter at least one wording (toggle, on, or off).
